sens_en: to fight over, to compete, to argue
origine_fr: Deux mains qui tirent un objet, chacune de son côté. On le dessinait déjà ainsi il y a plus de 3 000 ans. 争 garde ce dessin : se disputer, rivaliser, débattre.
origine_en: Two hands pulling at one object, each its own way. It was already drawn like this over 3,000 years ago. 争 keeps the picture: to fight over, to compete, to argue.

phrase.zh: 学生们都争着第一个到学校。
phrase.pinyin: Xuéshengmen dōu zhēngzhe dì yī gè dào xuéxiào.
phrase.fr: Les élèves veulent tous arriver les premiers à l'école.
phrase.en: The pupils all race to be the first to reach school.
